summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing it has filed its annual report on Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025. This is a routine regulatory filing by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. The filing contains no mention of any corporate transaction, activist activity, strategic review, or capital event. It simply notifies shareholders of the availability of the annual report. The form is used to comply with SEC reporting requirements under the Exchange Act. No deal terms, advisor names, or board recommendations are disclosed.
